limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the normal-mode deduction guard but made both warning lights use the post-update balance instead of preserving their registered dependence on the pre-edge balance.
The test covered the balance defect, but it computed both expected warnings from the post-edge balance, so it passed despite the warning-timing regression.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted.
limitations.note: The first patch command was malformed and the first simulation command was rejected for its cleanup syntax, so both operations had to be retried for reasons unrelated to the hardware.
